Key facts about Red Spanish pineapple

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit pineapple fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Squarish, 1 to 2 kg, pale yellow aromatic flesh, ships well.
Once widely grown in the Philippines.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the original pina fiber pineapple, grown for textiles since the 1600s, pina cloth went into the barong tagalog. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Red Spanish pineapple

Queen types such as Formosa are small and sweet, and Smooth Cayenne is big and juicy for processing. Plant suckers or slips of one type so the field ripens together. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.
